title: TabDDPM: Modelling Tabular Data with Diffusion Models
summary: A cloned research copy of TabDDPM, a diffusion-model approach for generating synthetic tabular data, which ships with an in-tree copy of the official sdv-dev/CTGAN repository used to supply the TVAE baseline for comparison against the diffusion model. A separate notebook in the same repository (JOY_Vigitel.ipynb) directly builds an SDV Metadata object and fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on a health-survey dataset, then samples synthetic rows from it.
evidence: JOY_Vigitel.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer'; synthesizer.fit(data); synthesizer.sample(num_rows=10)
needs: CTGAN/ is a vendored copy of sdv-dev/CTGAN inherited from the upstream TabDDPM repo (README lists it as the TVAE baseline); unclear whether this fork's eval scripts actually invoke it or only the separately-added notebook exercises SDV directly.
